message: Vector Rebel 3.2.69: in Daily Captain Check, mark regular crew Here/Off by shift and add swings for either day, then Recheck Missing rereads only outstanding PPE histories.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check now preloads the saved Captain Set and has a compact two-shift roster: mark any regular crew member Off or Here independently on Day 1/Day 2 and add/remove a swing person from the approved master roster for Day 1, Day 2 or both. The temporary attendance does not edit saved Captain Sets, CrewSense or PPE assignments; its due checks apply only on the selected tour, with original members retaining historical tour obligations and swings not inheriting old months. Results display OFF vs not-yet-due vs missing clearly, and Recheck Missing (N) selectively reads only PPE with missing due tours/unreadable required histories, preserving previously completed history. Existing version-7 reports are supported through bounded Responsible Party matching; no official inspections are created, edited, or submitted. SCBA prior release protections and in-progress queue compatibility are retained.
